subject: RFP: benchmark credits and evaluation window for CloudSense bake-off
messages:
From: Emily Jansen <emily@cloudsense.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T16:12:00-05:00
Subject: RFP: benchmark credits for CloudSense bake-off

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed by Redwood's latency numbers. We're running an internal bake-off next month against two other vendors as part of our RFP process (link to RFP attached). To make the evaluation apples-to-apples we typically request a short-term credit allocation for benchmark runs and a 30-day trial window.

Specifically we're asking for: 50k generation tokens + 10k embedding units, isolated workspace, and a shared support channel for the week of 12/6–12/12. Could you confirm whether Redwood can provide that under a short-term promo for procurement? We need the formal offering to include any usage caps and a point of contact for security/compliance questions (SOC2 scope, data deletion policy).

Attached: CloudSense_RFP_v2.pdf

Best,
Emily Jansen
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudSense

--
Emily Jansen
CloudSense
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jansen <emily@cloudsense.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T17:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: RFP: benchmark credits for CloudSense bake-off

Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. We're happy to support a bake-off. A couple quick clarifying items before I loop in procurement/security:

- Is the evaluation strictly a benchmark (automated runs) or will product engineers also run interactive sessions?
- Do you need a dedicated Dedicated (reserved) pool or is hosted-sandbox fine?
- Any compliance artifacts we should provide up-front (I can attach SOC2 scope and data retention docs).

If you confirm interactive sessions might occur, I'll ask for a slightly larger credit window and push for a 45-day trial so your engineers have time for integration work. Will loop in Ben (rev ops) for approval on credit amounts.

Best,
Soojin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

On Sun, Nov 29, 2026 at 4:12 PM Emily Jansen <emily@cloudsense.ai> wrote:
> Hi Soojin,
> 
> [Original message]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T18:21:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: RFP: benchmark credits for CloudSense bake-off

Ben / Naomi — forwarding the RFP request above. CloudSense is a priority mid-market prospect evaluating Redwoods for infra and inference economics. Summary:

- Ask: 50k gen tokens + 10k embed units; isolated workspace; support channel for 12/6–12/12
- Potential for expansion if Redwood wins the bake-off (procurement forecasted to ~ $120k ARR in Y1)
- Sensitive asks: SOC2 evidence + data deletion confirmation

My proposal: approve a 60k gen + 12k embed promo, 45-day trial window (start when workspace is created), and provide SOC2 summary + short data retention statement. Put a soft cap of 20 RPS on benchmark runs to maintain shared capacity. I recommend we require a signed trial-credit-agreement that limits usage for benchmark only.

Can you approve the credit top-up and the proposed gating language? If helpful I can draft the trial-credit-agreement.

Thanks — Soojin

[Attachment: CloudSense_RFP_v2.pdf]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T19:07:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP: benchmark credits for CloudSense bake-off

Soojin — sounds reasonable. Approve the promo under these conditions:

- Grant 60,000 generation tokens + 12,000 embedding units
- 45-day evaluation window starting on workspace creation
- Trial-credit-agreement must include: benchmark-only clause, explicit data deletion request within 30 days of trial end, and a one-way non-disclosure clause for shared benchmark prompts
- No SLA or uptime credits; this is a promotional trial not a commercial contract

Naomi — please confirm SOC2 bundle (pdf) and a two-paragraph data retention statement we can attach. I suggest we limit support channel to CSM office hours + one technical deep-dive meeting (1h) during the benchmark week.

Ben
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T20:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP: benchmark credits for CloudSense bake-off

Attaching SOC2 summary and short data retention language — see attached redwood-eval-terms-2026.pdf. Key points:

- SOC2: controls in scope: security, availability, confidentiality; summary page included
- Data deletion: ephemeral evaluation artifacts deleted 30 days after the trial unless customer requests retention via signed PO
- We can provide a limited support window (CSM office hours + 1x 60-min deep-dive) as Ben suggested

Happy to attach both docs to the trial package. Naomi
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood-eval-terms-2026.pdf]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jansen <emily@cloudsense.ai>, procurement@cloudsense.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:04:00-05:00
Subject: Re: RFP: benchmark credits for CloudSense bake-off — promo confirmed

Emily — good news: we can support the bake-off under the following terms (see attached trial-credit-agreement draft):

1) Credits: 60,000 generation tokens + 12,000 embedding units
2) Evaluation window: 45 days from workspace activation (we'll activate once you confirm)
3) Isolation: dedicated workspace in hosted sandbox; no production data access
4) Support: CSM office hours + one 60-minute technical deep dive during benchmark week (12/6–12/12)
5) Compliance: SOC2 summary and our data deletion statement attached; Redwood will delete evaluation artifacts 30 days after trial end unless CloudSense requests retention in writing
6) Usage guardrails: 20 RPS soft cap for automated benchmark runs; we can raise this if you sign a short-term capacity addendum
7) Agreement: Please sign the attached trial-credit-agreement (DocuSign link below) to accept the promo.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/agreements/73a9b2
HubSpot record: https://redwood.hubspot.com/DEAL-2026-3387

If that aligns, I'll provision the workspace and share support calendar slots.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

[Attachments: trial-credit-agreement.docx, redwood-eval-terms-2026.pdf]

Subject: Re: RFP: benchmark credits for CloudSense bake-off — promo confirmed

Thanks — that works for us. I've routed the DocuSign to our procurement lead and we'll sign the trial-credit-agreement today. Please provision the workspace once the agreement is executed; scheduling note: we prefer provisioning no later than 12/3 so we can do integration tests before the December 6 benchmark week.

Emily
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudSense
